# Scaler

> Scaler is an outcome-focused ed-tech platform by InterviewBit that provides tech upskilling programs, coding bootcamps, and career transformation through structured learning and placement assistance.

Scaler offers multiple learning pathways including Scaler Academy, Scaler School of Technology, Scaler School of Business, and Scaler Neovarsity. The platform focuses on software development, cloud computing, DevOps, data science, and AI & Machine Learning with capstone projects and job placement support.

## Key Topics

- Scaler Academy
- Tech Upskilling
- Coding Bootcamp
- Career Transformation
- Job Placement
- Software Development
- Data Science
- AI & Machine Learning
- Cloud Computing
- DevOps
- Professional Development
- Placement Assistance
- Capstone Projects
- InterviewBit
- Scaler Mobile App
